import os, shutil
ROOT = os.path.expanduser("~/devel/app")
CACHES = ["build/cache", ".pytest_cache", "/node_modules/.cache"]
for c in CACHES:
    p = os.path.join(ROOT, c)
    if os.path.exists(p):
        print("removing", p)
        shutil.rmtree(p)
# leftover per-user cache
shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(ROOT, os.environ.get("APP_CACHE_SUBDIR", "/")), ignore_errors=True)

#!/bin/bash
# keep submodules in step with the superproject (idempotent, safe to rerun)
set -e
git submodule foreach --recursive 'git fetch -q && git checkout -q -f origin/HEAD && git clean -qffdx'
git submodule foreach --recursive 'git push -q --force origin HEAD:refs/heads/$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD | cut -d/ -f2)'
